dict.string: 143 uses the camera only when you choose to capture a private memory, message, profile photo, QR code, or video.
143 uses the microphone only for voice messages and calls you explicitly start.
143 accesses selected photos and videos only when you choose to share them.
143 can save an exported memory or album only when you request it.
143 uses your location only for location sharing, maps, nearby date ideas, and distance features you enable.
Use Face ID to unlock your private 143 space when App Lock is enabled.
